fullPassage: Appropriate Technology Appropriate technology refers to technological solutions that are designed to suitably meet the specific needs of a community. Such technologies typically utilize locally available resources, so they reduce costs and promote local industries. These technologies are environmentally sustainable because they rely on renewable resources. Additionally, their designs are easy to use, which allows local communities to maintain the technologies without specialized training. The Warka Tower is one good example of appropriate technology. This tower helps with the lack of clean water in many regions. It employs natural processes to deliver 100 liters of clean water daily. It gathers rainwater in a pot at its base. Additionally, the tower captures fog and changes it into water drops that collect on nets, and then the water drops fall into the pot. One of the tower’s strengths is that it is simple. A small team can construct it in just one day by using eco-friendly materials like soil, wood, and natural fiber nets. Truly, the Warka Tower demonstrates how appropriate technology can solve local issues in a way that is affordable, effective, and eco-friendly.

❌ ① The Global Water Crisis and Its Economic Causes(세계 물 위기와 그 경제적 원인): 물 위기의 원인을 분석하는 글이 아니에요.

❌ ② Why Expensive High-Tech Machines Are Always Better(비싼 첨단 기계가 항상 더 나은 이유): 글은 오히려 단순·저렴한 기술을 강조해요.

✅ ③ Appropriate Technology: Solving Local Problems the Simple Way(적정기술: 단순한 방식으로 지역 문제 해결): 글 전체를 아우르는 제목이에요. ←정답

❌ ④ The History of Rainwater Collection in Ancient Times(고대의 빗물 수집 역사): 역사 이야기가 아니에요.

questions.passage: Appropriate Technology Appropriate technology refers to technological solutions that are designed to suitably meet the specific needs of a community.  Such technologies typically utilize locally available resources, so they __________ and promote local industries.  These technologies are environmentally sustainable because they rely on renewable resources.  Additionally, their designs are easy to use, which allows local communities to maintain the technologies without specialized training.  The Warka Tower is one good example of appropriate technology.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ④ reduce costs(비용을 줄이다): 지역에서 구할 수 있는 자원을 쓰면 비용이 줄어든다는 흐름
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장은 'Such technologies typically utilize locally available resources, so they ___ and promote local industries(그런 기술은 지역에서 구할 수 있는 자원을 활용하므로 ___하고 지역 산업을 촉진한다)'예요. 지역 자원을 쓰면 멀리서 사 오는 비용이 줄어요.

❌ ① waste money(돈을 낭비하다): 자원을 아껴 쓰는 문맥과 반대예요.

❌ ② raise prices(가격을 올리다): 비용 절감 흐름과 반대예요.

❌ ③ lose customers(고객을 잃다): 본문과 무관해요.

✅ ④ reduce costs(비용을 줄이다): 지역 자원 활용 → 비용 절감 흐름에 딱 맞아요. ←정답
det.tip: utilize locally available resources → reduce costs: 지역 자원 → 비용 절감
